items.label: This is a large loose bohemian style. Size
items.value: 9.5" (W) x 12" (H) x 7" (D) .Shoulder strap: fixed height 21“. It is bigger than A4 paper. It can accommodate iPad, books, sun umbrellas, etc. There is a mobile phone pocket and a zipper pocket inside. There is also a zipper pocket in the back.

items: This bag is closed with a zipper. Since the length of the shoulder strap is fixed, if the shoulder strap is not long enough, you can use it as a shoulder bag. This is also a good choice.

items.label: Fabric
items.value: Soft canvas. Lining: denim. Care: Hand wash only. Do not bleach.

items: this is printed hippie crossbody bag. Unique long sling design,Simple, casual and light, it's perfect for daily use like work, travel, shopping. Gift wishes.
The inside of the shoulder strap is made of denim. It is connected to the bag. It can withstand a certain amount of pulling force. It can be folded and compressed. It is very easy to carry.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand wash only. Do not bleach.
